cases.description: Design case: 30 C ambient, 94 % O2 recovery (ASSUMED)

design_basis: ASSUMED O2 recovery 94 % (no argon column, 99.5 % purity, 15 % Lachmann air).
ASSUMED MAC discharge 5.8 bara, HP column top 5.4 bara, LP column top 1.3 bara.
ASSUMED refrigeration by booster-braked expander, Lachmann air to the LP column, ~11,500 Nm3/h, ~250 kW refrigeration.
ASSUMED regeneration gas ~13,000 Nm3/h waste N2, heated electrically to 200 C.
ASSUMED DCAC air outlet 12 C via chilled water from an N2 evaporative cooler; no mechanical chiller.
ASSUMED GAN taken as pressurized N2 from the HP column top (~5.2 bara) and compressed to 9 bara.
ASSUMED all flows, pressures, duties and DNs are concept estimates, accuracy about +/-30 %.
